text: Developing a mobile app is an exciting but challenging process. One of the first decisions you face is choosing between native and cross-platform development. Native apps are built specifically for iOS or Android, offering excellent performance and smooth animations. Cross-platform tools, on the other hand, allow you to write one codebase that works on both systems, saving time and money, though sometimes at the cost of speed. Regardless of the approach, responsive design is crucial. Your app must look and work well on different screen sizes, from small phones to large tablets. Finally, remember that app stores are your main distribution channels. You must follow their guidelines, prepare clear descriptions, and test your app thoroughly to avoid crashes and negative reviews.
